title: Frontend Developer
description: We are looking for a Frontend Developer with experience in React, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. You will build responsive web applications for international clients. Requirements: 2+ years of experience, strong knowledge of REST APIs and Git.

title: Backend Developer (Python)
description: Join our team as a Backend Developer. You will design and maintain RESTful microservices using Python, Django or Flask, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Experience with Docker and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP) is a plus. BSc in Computer Science or equivalent.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: We seek a Full Stack Developer skilled in Laravel/PHP and Vue.js or React. Responsibilities include building new features, optimizing database queries, and collaborating with UI/UX designers. Minimum 3 years of experience.

title: Data Analyst
description: The Data Analyst will collect, process, and perform statistical analysis on business data. Required skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI or Tableau, and Python (Pandas). Strong analytical thinking and reporting in Arabic and English.

title: Mobile App Developer (Flutter)
description: We are hiring a Mobile Developer with strong Flutter/Dart experience to build cross-platform apps. Must understand state management (Provider/Riverpod), Firebase integration, and publishing to Google Play and App Store.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: We need a creative UI/UX Designer to design web and mobile interfaces. Must be proficient with Figma, Adobe XD, and prototyping tools. Portfolio demonstrating user-centered design is required.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: As a DevOps Engineer you will manage CI/CD pipelines, containerized applications (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure on AWS. Experience with Linux administration, Terraform, and monitoring tools (Grafana/Prometheus) is required.

title: Sales & Marketing Specialist
description: We are looking for a Sales and Marketing Specialist to develop marketing strategies and manage social media campaigns. Excellent communication skills in Arabic and English, experience with Google Ads and SEO, and a business or marketing degree.

title: Accountant
description: Immediate opening for an Accountant. Duties: manage financial records, prepare reports, and handle tax filings. Requirements: BSc in Accounting, 2+ years of experience, and proficiency in accounting software (QuickBooks/SAP).

title: Technical Support Engineer
description: We are hiring a Technical Support Engineer to provide IT support, maintain hardware and networks, and manage user accounts. Knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals is required.
